tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List every published Love Campus course and book across Dating, Marriage and Family, with exact IDs, USD prices and current book buyability. Optional college, kind, text and budget filters.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Full course and book catalog; alias of list_products. Prices are selected-product subtotals, not a complete basket quote.

tools.name: recommend_offer
tools.description: Rank suitable published courses and books using the buyer need, college, kind and USD budget. Explain personalized learning accurately; ask the customer to confirm suitability.

tools.name: prepare_purchase
tools.description: Prepare a fresh purchase handoff for any published available course or book, or one exact course+book pair. Pass productIds (one or two exact catalog IDs), or a single offerId; never both. Existing mc-bundle-one is supported. Customer reviews the whole basket and authorizes payment.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_offers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read the current owning catalog and quote service for Everyday Partnership and its exact Husbands Field Guide bundle." → after: "Full course and book catalog; alias of list_products. Prices are selected-product subtotals, not a complete basket quote."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
